phy-concurrency-audit 1.0.0

- Initial release: static concurrency and race-condition auditor for Go, Java, Python, and Node.js/TypeScript.
- Detects shared-state mutations without locks, TOCTOU (time-of-check-time-of-use) vulnerabilities, unsafe locking patterns, and common thread-safety bugs.
- Maps findings to CWE-362 (race condition) and CWE-367 (TOCTOU) for security relevance.
- No external dependencies beyond Python 3 stdlib; works offline.
- Offers broad static coverage across multiple languages for both correctness and security issues.
